readback_body:
## Goal

Complete the **MCP-only no-op exporter optimization** in the existing MCP Documents feature (parent Requirement #3624). The baseline generator, official upstream spec verifier and public UI are already merged to `staging`. This follow-up is intentionally a separate Issue because its branch starts with an existing `pages-mcp` browser spec: the original parent Issue's `### New` E2E declaration is correct for baseline PR #3627 but is not correct for a subsequent PR.

## Scope

- A previously published MCP JSON must first pass the canonical existing source/digest validator.
- Always revalidate the official upstream **stable** MCP release, including its immutable version/tag/changelog hash.
- On a valid prior snapshot and unchanged upstream stable release, compare last published main commit to currently pinned main via the bounded GitHub compare API. If the comparison is complete (less than one 100-commit page and 300 file cap), ancestor/source-head verified, and there are no edits to MCP/Protocol crates, cargo/toolchain inputs or MCP projection owner scripts, reuse the exact prior MCP JSON and **do not invoke cargo**.
- Every code/schema/upstream change, truncated/failed/divergent comparison, missing or malformed prior source, or other uncertainty falls back to the canonical Rust Tool exporter and existing MCP semantic reconciler, never a false no-op.
- No GPT monitor, no new cron, no MCP runtime invocation, no change to trusted Pages publisher workflow, and no alteration of other Documents semantics.

## Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01: Deterministic source-aware no-op preserves the previous published MCP JSON bytes and source revision without invoking the Rust exporter on a verified unrelated main change.
- [x] SC-02: All meaningful source/Tool/protocol/lock/upstream changes, missing/forged/truncated comparisons and renamed MCP files cannot silently skip regeneration.
- [ ] SC-03: Existing `pages-mcp` browser regression and Pages unit/security tests pass on exact PR HEAD. First public HTTPS Pages projection remains a separate parent acceptance dependency after main release.

### SC scenario → proof mapping
SC-01 and SC-02: pure unit fixtures and CI Pages static boundary (SCN-01). SC-03: existing independently executed `pages-mcp` Chromium spec and exact CI run (SCN-02). Deployed source/HTTPS readback remains owned by parent #3624.

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: agent
```

| SC-01 | Pass | run 43724720354; ref cfa3266a5e53d8d062c057e01f98ad75f8d9ab77; source agent-qwen; file: pages/scripts/mcp-export-gate.mjs - canReusePublishedMcp() implements source-aware no-op: validates previous publication, main SHA, upstream stable (version/sha/changelog_sha256), and bounded GitHub compare (< 100 commits, < 300 files) showing no MCP-affecting changes; file: pages/tests/mcp-export-gate.test.mjs:27-31 - Test 'unrelated bounded main changes skip MCP exporter and preserve prior source' verifies no-op path preserves previous.source.sha and returns true; file: pages/scripts/build.mjs:220-267 - Build orchestrator skips Rust exporter (cargo run -p nession-mcp) when canReusePublishedMcp() returns true, reusing exact previous publication bytes; file: pages/scripts/mcp-reconcile.mjs - validMcpPublication() validates complete publication structure before reuse; summary: Deterministic no-op correctly preserves previous MCP JSON bytes and source revision without invoking Rust exporter when source verified unchanged |
| SC-02 | Pass | run 43724720354; ref cfa3266a5e53d8d062c057e01f98ad75f8d9ab77; source agent-qwen; file: pages/scripts/mcp-export-gate.mjs - affectsMcpSource() detects changes to: crates/nession-mcp/, crates/nession-protocol/, .cargo/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, rust-toolchain, pages/scripts/build.mjs, mcp-semantic.mjs, mcp-export-gate.mjs; file: pages/scripts/mcp-export-gate.mjs - canReusePublishedMcp() enforces bounded compare: status='ahead', base matches previous SHA, head matches current SHA, ahead_by < 100 and equals total_commits, files.length < 300, every file (including renames via previous_filename) checked; file: pages/tests/mcp-export-gate.test.mjs:32-48 - Test verifies all Tool/protocol/dependency/projection-owner edits (10+ paths) demand reexport, including renamed files via previous_filename; file: pages/tests/mcp-export-gate.test.mjs:50-68 - Edge case tests: changed stable upstream triggers rebuild, invalid previous fails closed, unverifiable compare (diverged/truncated/wrong SHAs/too many commits/files) triggers rebuild; file: pages/scripts/mcp-upstream.mjs - Fetches verified official stable MCP release with tag commit SHA and changelog blob SHA validation; forged/unavailable/draft fails closed; summary: Comprehensive validation ensures all meaningful changes (Tool/protocol/lock/toolchain/upstream), missing/forged/truncated comparisons, and renamed MCP files cannot silently skip regeneration |
| SC-03 | Pending | run 43724720354; ref cfa3266a5e53d8d062c057e01f98ad75f8d9ab77; source agent-qwen; other: Issue #3653 E2E report: pages-mcp Pass at run 43723933937/1, SHA 2fd23cee64f871f25696c57b305edfa428bd41ed, tests 2/2 - but target_ref is cfa3266a5e53d8d062c057e01f98ad75f8d9ab77 (different SHA); file: e2e/tests/browser/pages-mcp.spec.ts - Existing pages-mcp Chromium browser regression test (referenced in ci-pages.yml workflow); file: .github/workflows/ci-pages.yml - CI workflow triggers on pages/** paths, runs standalone-page (unit/security) and pages-browser (Chromium smoke) jobs; other: ci_evidence is null in acceptance context - no harness-collected authenticated CI evidence available to verify tests passed at exact target_ref cfa3266a5; other: E2E evidence SHA (2fd23cee6) is parent of target_ref (cfa3266a5), not exact PR HEAD; cannot verify test execution at target_ref without authenticated CI metadata; summary: E2E evidence at SHA 2fd23cee6 (parent of target_ref cfa3266a5) not at exact PR HEAD; ci_evidence null prevents independent verification at target_ref |

## Knowledge Impact
- Decision: Read
- Related knowledge: parent MCP Documents #3624 and `pages/AGENTS.md`
- Reason: no new schema/API, only safe source-bound build optimization
- Owner and timing: Pages generator owner before merge

## Prototype

## Product alignment
Preserves minimal, verifiable source-backed AI capability docs without unnecessary Rust compilation or an independent monitoring service.
